missingEndpoints.description: SDK is missing the ListContacts method for Topics service to retrieve contacts subscribed to a specific topic
SDK is missing the ListVersions method for Forms service to retrieve all versions of a form
SDK is missing the CreateVersion method for Forms service to create a new version of an existing form
SDK is missing the Publish method for Forms service to publish a form

issues.title: Missing ListContacts method for Topics
issues.description: The TopicsSvc interface and TopicsSvcImpl do not implement the ListContacts method which is required to retrieve contacts subscribed to a specific topic
issues.recommendation: Add ListContacts and ListContactsWithContext methods to TopicsSvc interface and implement them in TopicsSvcImpl. The endpoint is GET /v1/topics/{topicId}/contacts

issues.title: Missing ListVersions method for Forms
issues.description: The FormsSvc interface and FormsSvcImpl do not implement the ListVersions method which is required to retrieve all versions of a form
issues.recommendation: Add ListVersions and ListVersionsWithContext methods to FormsSvc interface and implement them in FormsSvcImpl. The endpoint is GET /v1/forms/{formId}/versions

issues.title: Missing CreateVersion method for Forms
issues.description: The FormsSvc interface and FormsSvcImpl do not implement the CreateVersion method which is required to create a new version of an existing form
issues.recommendation: Add CreateVersion and CreateVersionWithContext methods to FormsSvc interface and implement them in FormsSvcImpl. The endpoint is POST /v1/forms/{formId}/versions

issues.title: Missing Publish method for Forms
issues.description: The FormsSvc interface and FormsSvcImpl do not implement the Publish method which is required to publish a form
issues.recommendation: Add Publish and PublishWithContext methods to FormsSvc interface and implement them in FormsSvcImpl. The endpoint is POST /v1/forms/{formId}/publish

issues.title: Missing subscribedAt and unsubscribedAt fields in Contact struct
issues.description: The Contact struct in contacts.go is missing subscribedAt and unsubscribedAt fields which are returned by the API according to the OpenAPI spec
issues.recommendation: Add SubscribedAt and UnsubscribedAt string fields with json tags to the Contact struct

issues.title: Missing status field in CreateContactRequest struct
issues.description: The CreateContactRequest struct is missing the status field which is supported by the API for setting initial contact status
issues.recommendation: Add Status string field with json tag to CreateContactRequest struct. Valid values: SUBSCRIBED, UNSUBSCRIBED, BOUNCED, COMPLAINED, ARCHIVED

issues.title: Missing defaultValue field in CreateContactPropertyRequest
issues.description: The CreateContactPropertyRequest struct is missing the optional defaultValue field which is supported by the API
issues.recommendation: Add DefaultValue *string field with json tag 'defaultValue,omitempty' to CreateContactPropertyRequest struct

issues.title: Missing defaultValue field in ContactProperty struct
issues.description: The ContactProperty struct is missing the defaultValue field which is returned by the API
issues.recommendation: Add DefaultValue *string field with json tag to ContactProperty struct

issues.title: Topic struct missing object field
issues.description: The Topic struct has an Object field but the List response schema in OpenAPI does not include object in individual topic items
issues.recommendation: Verify if the object field is returned in Topic items from the API. If not, consider making it optional

issues.title: Form struct missing version field
issues.description: The Form struct is missing the version field which is returned when getting form versions
issues.recommendation: Add Version *int field with json tag 'version,omitempty' to Form struct

issues.title: ListApiKeysResponse missing hasPrevious field alignment
issues.description: The ListApiKeysResponse includes hasPrevious but the OpenAPI spec for api-keys list response may not include it consistently
issues.recommendation: Verify that hasPrevious is actually returned by the API for consistency

issues.title: ApiKey struct has updatedAt but OpenAPI list response doesn't include it
issues.description: The ApiKey struct includes updatedAt field but the OpenAPI spec for list API keys response only shows createdAt
issues.recommendation: Verify if updatedAt is returned by the API. If not, remove it or make it optional

issues.title: Properties field type uses map[string]interface{} instead of string|number
issues.description: The Contact.Properties field uses map[string]interface{} but OpenAPI spec indicates values should be string or number only
issues.recommendation: Consider using a more specific type or adding validation to ensure only string and number values are used

issues.title: Inconsistent error naming pattern
issues.description: Error variable names use pattern ErrFailedToCreate{Resource}{Action}Request which is verbose
issues.recommendation: Consider simplifying to Err{Resource}{Action} pattern for consistency with Go conventions

issues.title: CreateFormRequest.Fields uses interface{} instead of []interface{}
issues.description: CreateFormRequest.Fields uses interface{} type but UpdateFormRequest.Fields uses []interface{} - these should be consistent
issues.recommendation: Update CreateFormRequest.Fields to use []interface{} for consistency with UpdateFormRequest

recommendations.description: Implement the missing Topics.ListContacts method to retrieve contacts subscribed to a topic
Implement the missing Forms.ListVersions, Forms.CreateVersion, and Forms.Publish methods for complete form management
Add missing fields to Contact struct: subscribedAt, unsubscribedAt
Add missing status field to CreateContactRequest for setting initial contact status
Add defaultValue field to CreateContactPropertyRequest and ContactProperty structs
Add version field to Form struct for version tracking
Align CreateFormRequest.Fields type with UpdateFormRequest.Fields for consistency
